exempt.Lms.DifftestMain: the difftest against verity/ml/crypto/lms.py, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of Lms.Difftest.main, audited under Lms, a test and not a proof
exempt.Lms.SignDifftestMain: the sign difftest against verity/ml/crypto/lms.py, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of Lms.SignDifftest.main, audited under Lms, a test and not a proof

Lms.DifftestMain.why: 600 instances, keys at every parameter set Params admits (N = 64 and TOY_N, W = 1, 2, 4, 8, heights 1 to 5, and DEPLOYED's height 20, 11 and 30 under a stand-in tree), their signatures and tampered ones, on which Lms.Verify gives what verity/ml/crypto/lms.py gives: Params' admission, Signature.decode, digits, root_of and every accept and reject of verify

Lms.SignDifftestMain.why: 80 instances, keys at N = 64 (W = 1, 2, 4) and at TOY_N (every W) of heights 1 to 4, from keygen and from key, with seeds and identifiers of the right length and of others, and parameter sets Params refuses, on which Lms.Sign gives what verity/ml/crypto/lms.py gives: the public key, each sign_at's signature byte for byte (every leaf, or a sample, and leaves past 2^H refused) and verify's verdict on it

Lms.Verify.why: the verifier is code: Lean core and C-Flock's hashes and bytes only, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

Lms.Sign.why: signing is code: Lean core and the verifier's definitions only, no Mathlib and nothing of Security
